subject: Greenfield deployment — data residency & audit access / exec escalation
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@storamet.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example>
Cc: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@storamet.com>, ProcureOps <procure@storamet.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenfield deployment — residency & audit questions

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Storamet's security team reviewed the SOW and we have two items that are blockers for procurement to finish: 1) data residency must be strictly within EU-Frankfurt for both model inference and logs; 2) audit scope — our legal wants on-prem-style audit rights, including the ability to request copies of request logs and, in a high-priority incident, a temporary snapshot of certain logs for a 30-day window.

We attached the security questionnaire and an annotated SOW (please see Storamet_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, audit_questionnaire.xlsx). Also, because this is our pilot, procurement is asking if you can apply a one-time onboarding discount of 18% and commit to a two-week deployment SLA from final signature.

Can you confirm what is feasible? If some of these need exec sign-off, please escalate and let us know an expected timeline — we need to present to our board on 9/20.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
VP Product & Security 
Storamet Health

--
Attachment: Storamet_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: audit_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@storamet.com>, ProcureOps <procure@storamet.com>
Cc: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@storamet.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenfield deployment — residency & audit questions

Elena —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Short answers up front: EU-Frankfurt tenancy for inference and logs is supported on our Private plan; we can route all inference and persistent logs to the customer's VPC in the Frankfurt region. Audit access needs a bit more nuance — we typically provide:

- Tenant-level access to system and application logs (redacted for PII) via a secure log bundle (S3 presigned link or SFTP)
- Timeboxed access for audits (we do not hand over raw PII-containing datasets)
- Live access for joint incident triage through a shared collaboration channel

The request for a 30-day snapshot in a high-priority incident is doable with conditions: we need a narrow definition of "snapshot scope" (which fields, token-level vs request metadata) and an approval process for production snapshots. That policy is reviewed by Legal and Product.

Regarding the 18% onboarding discount and a 2-week deployment SLA — that requires Deal Desk + Exec approval for two reasons: the discount exceeds our standard onboarding cap, and the SLA is tighter than our Dedicated/Private baseline. I'm looping in Rishi (legal) and Laura (revops) to advise next steps and to escalate for an exec decision.

Couple of asks for your team to help speed this:
- Confirm the exact log fields you need in the 30-day snapshot (example: request_id, timestamp, request_headers, response_trace — note we redact model prompt text by default)
- Confirm the primary contact for deployment (name + infra lead)
- Any additional compliance forms we should receive before RFP close

I will follow up once I have guidance from Legal and RevOps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.example | +1 (415) 555-0138

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.example>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Greenfield deployment — residency & audit questions

Marissa —

Escalating per your note. Summary of legal view after a quick review of the attachments:

1) Data residency: ok to commit to EU-Frankfurt for inference and persistent system logs. We should avoid committing to "on-prem" access; instead, offer: Private deployment with the customer's VPC, customer-held encryption keys (KMS) in region, and a written data residency clause.

2) Audit scope: redline suggestions attached (high level):
- Allow customer to request timebound exports of request metadata and system logs (request_id, timestamps, status codes, platform traces).
- Prohibit export of raw prompt/response text unless a court order or explicit incident criteria are met; in those cases, exports require a joint review and redaction step.
- For a "high-priority incident" snapshot, limit to 14 days by default with exec approval to extend to 30 days and explicit justification.

3) SLA & pricing: Rishi notes in deal desk guidance — a one-time 18% onboarding discount is above our standard 10% cap for new Private contracts; approving 18% would need executive sign-off (CRO or CEO) and Deal Desk narrative. A 2-week deployment SLA is aggressive; acceptable only if the customer accepts a single-zone rollout and paid accelerated onboarding services (we should quantify $).

I've drafted redline language for the SOW and highlighted the clauses that need exec approval. Attaching the redline in the company drive (link below). Recommend we request Elena's log-field list, then present a short 1‑page decision memo for execs: ask = approve up to 18% onboarding credit & approve 30-day incident snapshot (only with exec sign-off trigger).

Rishi
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

--
Related link: https://drive.redwood.internal/rdw/deals/RDW-2026-4487/redlines

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.example>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenfield deployment — residency & audit questions

Team —

Thanks for the summary, Rishi. Quick commercial decision: I'm willing to provisionally approve an 18% one-time onboarding credit for Storamet provided the following conditions are accepted and documented in the decision memo: 

1) Customer accepts our standard limitation on raw prompt/response exports; any exception requires explicit exec sign-off with documented justification and a signed addendum.
2) Incident snapshot max duration is 14 days by default; extension to 30 days must be requested through an exec escalation and logged in our audit trail.
3) Customer agrees to pay for accelerated onboarding (I want $20k upfront to cover hands-on deployment & single-zone priority lane).
4) We will commit to EU-Frankfurt for inference and non-PII system logs; PII handling follows the data processing addendum (DPA).

Operational notes for Karthik: please prepare a simple runbook for single-zone rollout and confirm the realistic lead time. If Karthik signs off on the two-week timeline under the accelerated onboarding cost, we can include that in the approval memo.

Marissa — please prepare the 1-pager (bullet points + ask) for exec signature. Rishi — please attach the redline and proposed SOW wording. I'll review and sign the memo by EOD tomorrow if the conditions are captured.

Laura Bennett
SVP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.example

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@storamet.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.example>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@storamet.com>, Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@storamet.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenfield deployment — residency & audit questions

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick escalation and the clarity. We can accept the conditions Laura outlined, with one ask: can you confirm the $20k accelerated onboarding fee and provide a high-level SOW milestone list (kickoff, infra provisioning, verification, go-live) so our board sees the timeline? If Laura signs by EOD tomorrow, we'll route the signed SOW through procurement the following day.

I'll send the exact log-field list by EOD. Thanks again for moving fast.

Best,
Elena
